model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява разпределението на различни компоненти в две групи, обозначени като (a) и (b). Всяка диаграма съдържа по шест сегмента. В диаграма (a) сегментите са: 31% светлосиньо, 21% тъмносиньо, 17% зелено, 15% оранжево, 15% светлозелено и 9% светлосиво. В диаграма (b) сегментите са: 38% червено-кафяво, 27% светлооранжево, 19% жълто, 15% светлокафяво, 15% синьо и 9% светлосиво. И двете диаграми включват легенда, която идентифицира компонентите, както и процентни стойности, показани вътре във всеки сегмент. Сегментите в двете диаграми са подредени визуално в низходящ ред по размер.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart presents a comparison of proportions across two datasets, labeled (a) and (b). Chart (a) contains six slices representing categories labeled “this,” “for,” “chemical,” “to,” “in,” and “equilibrium,” colored light blue, light green, light orange, light yellow, light brown, and dark blue respectively. The slices represent approximately 9%, 15%, 31%, 15%, 17%, and 21% of the whole, with percentage labels displayed inside each slice. Chart (b) also contains six slices, labeled “the,” “$,” “equilibrium,” “consatant,” and two unlabeled slices, colored light yellow, light orange, light brown, light red, light brown, and dark blue. These slices represent approximately 15%, 19%, 38%, 27%, and 21% of the whole, with percentage labels displayed inside each slice. A legend is present above both charts, indicating the color associated with each label. The slices in both charts appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their visual size.
model_annotations.German: Die beiden Kreisdiagramme zeigen die Verteilung von Anteilen innerhalb zweier unterschiedlicher Datensätze, bezeichnet als (a) und (b). Jedes Diagramm besteht aus sechs Segmenten. Diagramm (a) enthält die Segmente "this", "for", "chemical", "to", "in" und "III", in den Farben Blau, Grün, Hellgrün, Orange, Grau und Gelb, mit den jeweiligen Anteilen von 31%, 21%, 17%, 15%, 15% und 9%. Diagramm (b) zeigt die Segmente "the", "$", "equilibrium", "consatant", "in" und "III", in den Farben Gelb, Rosa, Hellbraun, Blau, Grau und Grün, mit den Anteilen 38%, 27%, 19%, 15%, 9% und 7%. Beide Diagramme verfügen über eine Legende, die die Farben den jeweiligen Bezeichnungen zuordnet, und die prozentualen Anteile sind direkt innerhalb der Segmente angegeben. Die Segmente in beiden Diagrammen scheinen in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer Größe angeordnet zu sein. Keine Segmente sind visuell hervorgehoben, wie beispielsweise durch Verschiebung oder Fettdruck.
